exec: // A freshly registered/logged-in user always has role 'user' (see Auth > Register), which grants no capabilities by default - users:managePermissions is deliberately excluded from every role's default bundle (owner-granted only), so this route's guard should reject it regardless of role.
pm.test('Status code is 403 (default user lacks users:managePermissions capability)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

// requireOwner (not requirePermission) gates this route - a freshly registered second-or-later user is never the owner (only the very first user ever registered is, see Auth > Register), so this should be rejected regardless of role/capabilities.
pm.test('Status code is 403 (default user is not the owner)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.description: QA-15: staff-scheduled private lessons. Per-lesson billing to the account ledger (category private_lesson), posted lazily once each lesson ends. Never shown on the public calendar.

request.description: The signed-in family's lessons (active, or ended with dates still to come) with the next few occurrences and instructor. Staff notes are never included. Posts charges for lessons already taught first.

Every lesson with account, instructor, staff notes and upcoming occurrences. Requires privates:manage.
Requires privates:manage.

Every occurrence in [from, to) (at most 62 days), cancelled ones included, sorted by when they happen. Closed dates skip occurrences unless they were moved. Optional instructorStaffId filter. Requires privates:manage; there is no public version.
One account's lessons, for the front desk account view. Requires privates:manage or registrations:desk.
Replaces the lesson (the billed account can't change). Lessons already taught are charged at the old rate first. A new day or time on a lesson that has already started applies from today on.
Cancels one date; it is not charged. Rejected (409) once that lesson has started.
Moves one date (identified by its scheduled date) to a new date and time. Replaces any earlier change for that date. Rejected once the lesson has started or if the new time has passed.
Puts the occurrence back on its scheduled date and time. 404 when that date has no change.
Nothing after lastDate (default: today, studio time) is scheduled or charged. Charges already posted stay.
Only for a lesson that was never charged (409 otherwise; end it instead).
